ext.description: Offline language server for exported VBA projects, COM type indexes, form previews and read-only AI context tools.
view.symbols.name: VBA Symbols
cmd.extractComTypeIndex: VBAdminx: Extract COM Type Index from Windows
cmd.discoverCom: VBAdminx: Discover COM Libraries from Installed Software
cmd.configureGo: VBAdminx: Configure OpenCode Go API Key
cmd.clearGoKey: VBAdminx: Delete Saved OpenCode Go API Key
config.language.description: Interface language for commands, prompts and previews. Auto follows the VS Code display language and falls back to English. Command palette and view titles follow the VS Code language.
config.language.enum.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.format.lineWrap: Insert line continuations in provably safe long argument lists.
config.format.reorderDeclarations: Sort only safe consecutive Dim declarations.
config.format.formatDesign: Allow layout-only formatting of the form design section. Properties and values are preserved.
config.diagnostics.missingInformation: Diagnostic severity when type or host information is missing.
config.diagnostics.nameCase: Report name case differences between declarations and references.
config.snippets.customPath: Path to an extra VBA snippet file (JSON with VS Code snippet syntax), relative to the workspace or absolute. Leave empty to disable. Use "VBAdminx: Edit VBA Snippets" to create and edit it.
config.com.softwareList: Software or type library names used by "VBAdminx: Discover COM Libraries". Each name is matched case-insensitively against registered TypeLib descriptions, for example Excel, Word, ADODB, Scripting.
config.go.enabled: Register the Go model in VS Code. Model services are contacted only when a chat request or connection check is made.
config.go.connection: magpie uses the local proxy; direct uses the official Go API and requires a separate API key.
config.go.baseUrl: Base URL of the Magpie OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint. In direct mode the official fixed URL is used. Loopback addresses belong to the remote extension host in remote environments.
config.go.model: Model ID for the Magpie proxy. direct mode always uses deepseek-v4.1-flash.
tool.context.userDescription: Read the selection, diagnostics, project symbols, or resolved references of the active VBA file.
